title: Idioms and proverbs
summary: Use everyday idioms built on parts of the body (*göz kulak olmak*, *ağzından kaçırmak*), recognize and quote common proverbs, see which parts of an idiom change, and use *gibi* similes such as *buz gibi* and *kuzu gibi*.
canDo: Use common body idioms with the case each one takes
Recognize common proverbs and quote one at the right moment
Change the possessive inside an idiom to fit the person
Use everyday gibi similes such as buz gibi, kuzu gibi and bal gibi
